lines: The scripture comes down — hear it now, in season.
Siddhas signpost it, gurus unfold:
Bhairava's house, Goddess, and Svacchanda hold.
sanskrit_cite: śrīsiddhādivinirdiṣṭā gurubhiśca nirūpitā | bhairavo bhairavī devī svacchando lākulo@ṇurāṭ

lines: Nine teachers read the nine-crore sea,
drawn coin by coin from plenty.
sanskrit_cite: gahaneśo@bjajaḥ śakro guruḥ koṭyapakarṣataḥ | navabhiḥ kramaśo@dhītaṃ navakoṭipravistaram

lines: Quarters fly from every crore of song —
half to Dakṣa's house, half where Saṃvartas belong.
sanskrit_cite: etaistato guruḥ koṭimātrāt pādaṃ vitīrṇavān | dakṣādibhya ubhau pādau saṃvartādibhya eva ca

lines: Vāmana's folk a fourth, Bhṛgu's half of that;
Bali a crumb, and one crumb more unclaimed.
sanskrit_cite: pādaṃ ca vāmanādibhyaḥ pādārdhaṃ bhārgavāya ca | pādapādaṃ tu balaye pādapādastu yo@paraḥ

lines: Lion takes half, Eagle two cuts, Snake a fourth part —
count the shards: seventeen in all.
sanskrit_cite: siṃhāyārdhaṃ tataḥ śiṣṭāddvau bhāgau vinatābhuve | pādaṃ vāsukināgāya khaṇḍāḥ saptadaśa tvamī

lines: Heaven's half to Laṅkā's king, half to the bowman's hand,
then pupil after pupil down the guru-band.
sanskrit_cite: svargādardhaṃ rāvaṇo@tha jahre rāmo@rdhamapyataḥ | vibhīṣaṇamukhādāpa guruśiṣyavidhikramāt

lines: Nineteen shards, and every shard eightfold —
division, not decay, by quarters told.
sanskrit_cite: khaṇḍairekānnaviṃśatyā vibhaktaṃ tadabhūttataḥ | khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cāṣṭakhaṇḍaṃ proktapādādibhedataḥ

lines: Root and relic, latter lore and rule of rite —
threefold the weave, threefold the light.
sanskrit_cite: pādo mūloddhārāvuttaravṛhaduttare tathā kalpaḥ | sāṃhitakalpaskandāvanuttaraṃ vyāpakaṃ tridhā tisraḥ

lines: Goddesses in rank and splendor spread;
the ninth room holds no number — difference fled.
sanskrit_cite: devyo@tra nirūpyante kramaśo vistāriṇaiva rūpeṇa | navame pade tu gaṇanā na kāciduktā vyavacchidāhīne

lines: Rāma to brother, brother to the wise,
wise to demons, demons to the hidden eyes,
hidden to yogins, yogins to the crowned.
sanskrit_cite: rāmācca lakṣmaṇastasmāt siddhāstebhyo@pi dānavāḥ | guhyakāśca tatastebhyo yogino nṛvarāstataḥ

lines: Time frayed the thread between the hands;
at Śrīkaṇṭha's word the Wise came down.
sanskrit_cite: teṣāṃ krameṇa tanmadhye bhraṣṭaṃ kālāntarādyadā | tadā śrīkaṇṭhanāthājñāvaśāt siddhā avātaram

lines: Three sons, three visions — One, Two, Two-in-One —
each a master in Śiva's school.
sanskrit_cite: tryambakāmardakābhikhyaśrīnāthā advaye dvaye | dvayādvaye ca nipuṇāḥ krameṇa śivaśāsane

lines: Son's blood and daughter's blood both ran true —
the daughter's house the elder name renews.
sanskrit_cite: ādyasya cānvayo jajñe dvitīyo duhitṛkramāt | sa cārdhatryambakābhikhyaḥ saṃtānaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ

lines: Four and a half hearths, pupil-piled and wide,
a hundred branches from a single side.
sanskrit_cite: ataścārdhacatasro@tra maṭhikāḥ saṃtatikramāt | śiṣyapraśiṣyairvistīrṇāḥ śataśākhaṃ vyavasthitaiḥ

lines: Press the stream and drink its ripest hue —
this Tantra flows with every taste for you.
What was worth the keeping, keep —
so the descent finds harvest, and the sowing sleep.
